scenarios.name: returns-zombies-tapped-and-destroys-humans
scenarios.why: All Zombie creature cards in the caster's graveyard return to the battlefield tapped, then all Humans are destroyed. A Human noted in the caster's graveyard stays a graveyard card (only Zombies return), and the Zombie returns tapped.

scenarios.name: no-zombies-in-graveyard-and-no-humans-leaves-board
scenarios.why: With no Zombie cards in the caster's graveyard and no Humans on the battlefield, the spell resolves doing nothing.
